summary: LandBridge Company LLC filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary DBR Land Holdings LLC priced an upsized private placement of $125 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% senior notes due 2030 at 99.375% of par, up from $100 million. The notes are additional securities under a November 25, 2025 indenture that already governs $500 million of identical existing notes, and will trade as the same series. Expected closing is October 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds will repay revolving credit facility borrowings. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
